## SRI LANKA — profile (page 217)

- **Header facts:** Region: South Asia; Income group: Upper-middle-income; Lending category: IDA; Data status: Data as reported (A); Population: 21.8 million; GNI: 106,803; Unit line: US$ million, unless otherwise indicated.
- **Total external debt stock, 2025:** 57,658, **+1.4% from 2024**.

- **Figure 1. Total external debt, 2015–25:**  
  Start value **43,927** (2015); end value **57,658** (2025). The line rises from 2015 through the late 2010s and early 2020s, reaching its highest point in **≈2023**, then falls in **≈2024** and edges up slightly in **2025**.

- **Figure 2. External debt by creditor and creditor type in 2025, including IMF credit and SDR allocations:**  
  - **Total external debt:** 57,658
    - **Public & publicly guaranteed:** 42,517
    - **Private nonguaranteed:** 8,949
    - **Short-term:** 6,193
  - **Public & publicly guaranteed — by creditor type:** 42,517
    - **Multilateral:** 16,462
    - **Bilateral:** 15,078
    - **Private creditors:** 10,976
  - **Multilateral:** 16,462
    - **Asian Dev. Bank:** 7,379
    - **World Bank-IDA:** 3,669
    - **Other multilateral:** 5,414
  - **Bilateral:** 15,078
    - **China:** 8,766
    - **Japan:** 2,348
    - **Other bilateral:** 3,964

- **Figure 3. Debt ratios, 2015–25:**  
  - **External debt / exports:** **272%**, **-3.1%**. Trend: rises to a peak in the middle of the period, then declines and is broadly flat to slightly down by 2025.  
  - **External debt / GNI:** **54%**, **-7.9%**. Trend: gradual rise through most of the period, a sharper peak in the early 2020s, then declines by 2025.  
  - **Debt service / exports:** **26%**, **+11.1%**. Trend: volatile; rises early, dips around the early 2020s, then rebounds by 2025.  
  - **Debt service / GNI:** **5%**, **+5.6%**. Trend: rises to an early-2020s peak, then falls and recovers modestly by 2025.

- **Figure 4. Average terms on new commitments from official and private creditors, 2025:**  
  - **Official creditors:** Maturity **24 yrs**; Grace period **5 yrs**; Interest rate **3.3%**  
  - **Private creditors:** Maturity **..**; Grace period **..**; Interest rate **..**

- **Notes/Source:**  
  Note: Figure 4 shows no data values for private creditors because the country did not have new commitments in 2025.  
  Source: World Bank Group International Debt Statistics database.
